question: Does seemingly safe low MVRV after positive BTC trend still expose investors to large AFTER-RALLY maximum peak-to-trough future drawdowns not detected by loss relative to signal date?
features: Use exactly frozen 684 BTCI v8.18d model membership with no re-thresholding, MVRV always current-backfilled NOT original vintage.
sample: 684 distinct Sundays, BTC original CoinMetrics daily 2010-2026, future 13/26/52wk available. Original first-day reference price must SHA match parent daily source and BTCI reference, else stop.

outcomes.PEAK2TROUGH13: Worst daily closing drawdown after any intervening daily-close new high since signal day <=-20% within 13w
outcomes.FROMSTART26: Any daily close <= -35% vs original signal day within 26w (should equal frozen DOWN26; exact audit)
outcomes.TIME_UP50_26: First day of daily reference price >=150% of signal day, horizon 182 days. Daily and weekly success definitions intentionally different; no backdating.
outcomes.TIME_DOWN35_26: First day from original signal <=65% of signal within 182 days; if no crossing NULL
outcomes.FIRST_EVENT: Which of +50% and -35% first within 26w; BOTH same day tie possible, no eventual outcome assumption

metrics: For each model 684 cohort and 14wk spaced warning first; counts and rates of PEAK2TROUGH13/26/52 and FROMSTART26, median time-to-first +50 or -35 among observed, and dual path outcomes. Era 2012,2013-16,2017-19,2020-23,2024-25.
sourcePit: BTC PriceUSD historic retrospective and onchain MVRV reconstructed; model is not prospective and price original-vintage PIT unverified, no investment recommendations.
storage: Versioned R2 research report JSON manifest with SHA GET readback and Github artifact.
noChanges: No Spot Futures NAV reserve PnL capital MASTER Detector or trading limits.
